say:1:1422225001:0.text: Those who've left are considering leaving the mech guards behind. To them, the guards serve no practical purpose and aren't worth the high transport cost.
say:1:1422225001:0.source_cn: 那些已经离开地底的矮人，说什么机械守卫的运输成本太高，...

say:2:1422225002:0.text: They have no idea how capable those guards are! With our modifications, they'll only get better and better!
say:2:1422225002:0.source_cn: 铁脑袋们很能干！而且在我们的改造下，它们会越来越能干！

say:3:1422225003:1.text: Abandoning them? I won't let that happen.
say:3:1422225003:1.source_cn: 我绝对不接受这样的安排。

say:4:1422225004:1.text: Can we make the guards smaller?
say:4:1422225004:1.source_cn: 有没有可能把铁脑袋们改造成更小的体型……

say:5:1422225005:1.text: Or can we build a giant machine that can move them all at once?
say:5:1422225005:1.source_cn: 或者直接造一台大型运输机，把它们都运上去！
